title: MA61031: Similarity Transformations And Perturbation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Partial Differential EquationsGeneral dimensional theory, Global
similarity transformations, Transformation Groups, Infinitesimal
Transformations, Invariant Functions, Prolongation and Invariance of
Differential Equations (ODE and PDE), Invariant Solutions (Similarity
